capabilities.name: API monetization
capabilities.description: Identify your API's consumers with keys, package prices and edge-enforced request limits as named plans that warn consumers before their cap, price usage with versioned rate cards (monthly included requests, graduated tiers, and per-route weights), and produce revisioned usage statements to invoice through your own billing system.

capabilities.name: Application inbox and outbox
capabilities.description: Reliably send work to another Gregale app or deliver a signed custom event to a registered webhook without operating a separate broker or delivery subsystem.

capabilities.name: Circuit breaking
capabilities.description: Stop routing to an instance that is failing in transport, and probe it back into service once it recovers.

capabilities.name: Application companions
capabilities.description: Attach a bounded helper such as an OpenTelemetry collector, database proxy, or custom reverse proxy to an application instance.

capabilities.name: Container deployments
capabilities.description: Deploy a stateless Linux/amd64 Docker or OCI image without rewriting it as a function.

capabilities.name: Continuous CPU profiling
capabilities.description: Attribute sampled application CPU time to functions and call paths, compare deployment capture windows, save investigations with authenticated sharing and expiry status, check saved comparisons for coverage-aware CPU regressions, and opt in to automatic checks after deployments with saved results.

capabilities.name: Custom domains
capabilities.description: Serve an API on a customer-owned domain with managed TLS.

capabilities.name: Declarative response caching
capabilities.description: Cache selected GET and HEAD responses by route with bounded freshness, explicit purge hooks, stale-while-revalidate, and an optional distributed Redis tier.

capabilities.name: Delayed execution
capabilities.description: Schedule a durable one-shot app invocation for a future time without operating a queue, cron service, or external scheduler.

capabilities.name: Gregale Dev Bridge
capabilities.description: Run one HTTP service locally while its frontend and dependencies stay in a selected Gregale development environment.

capabilities.name: Disposable isolated runs
capabilities.description: Execute untrusted Node.js or Python source in a fresh, networkless Firecracker microVM with bounded time, memory, and output.

capabilities.name: Durable inbound webhooks
capabilities.description: Accept a provider webhook while an app is asleep, persist it before acknowledging, then wake and deliver with retries and dead-lettering.

capabilities.name: Dependency circuit breaking
capabilities.description: Fail an app's connections to a declared upstream fast while that upstream is unhealthy, instead of letting each request wait out a full connect timeout.

capabilities.name: Customer-aware feature flags
capabilities.description: Release deployed application behavior to selected platform customers with sticky rollout, decision explanations, and request cohort evidence.

capabilities.name: Firecracker isolation
capabilities.description: Run each workload in an isolated Firecracker microVM.

capabilities.name: Framework profiles
capabilities.description: Detect common API frameworks and suggest a start command, port, and health path.

capabilities.name: GitHub deployments
capabilities.description: Deploy an API from a connected GitHub repository and ref.

capabilities.name: Gregale Commit
capabilities.description: Connect a committed PostgreSQL outbox event to durable Gregale work through a managed polling relay.

capabilities.name: Internal services
capabilities.description: Call another app in the same account by a stable internal name, with no VPC, service registry, or DNS configuration. A parked target is woken by the call, and callers may opt into a declared-binding allowlist.

capabilities.name: Gregale Issues
capabilities.description: Group instrumented failures across releases, assign ownership, track resolution and recurrence, and inspect verified request, worker, and customer context.

capabilities.name: Managed exclusive operations
capabilities.description: Coordinate selected app and Job work under durable named keys, with explicit contention behavior, recurring Job and trigger admission, renewable ownership, and generation-fenced results.

capabilities.name: Managed PostgreSQL
capabilities.description: Provision and bind a managed PostgreSQL database to an API.

capabilities.name: MCP hosting
capabilities.description: Scaffold and deploy stateless Streamable HTTP MCP servers with explicit client access, protocol diagnostics, verified tool discovery, and optional PostgreSQL-backed durable Tasks that can run in a separate Gregale worker app.

capabilities.name: Private object storage
capabilities.description: Use private managed object buckets and signed URLs from an API.

capabilities.name: OpenAPI contract preview
capabilities.description: Compare declared routes with observed routes and matching edge policy before deployment.

capabilities.name: Pull-request previews
capabilities.description: Create an isolated, reviewable API URL for a pull request.

capabilities.name: Private apps
capabilities.description: Keep an app off the public edge entirely while it stays reachable over authenticated same-account service routing.

capabilities.name: Production route budgets
capabilities.description: Check absolute per-route error and p95 budgets against the serving production deployment, with incidents, per-customer impact, regression webhooks and opt-in automatic rollback of early error-budget incidents.

capabilities.name: Progressive rollouts and rollback
capabilities.description: Shift traffic between immutable deployment revisions, advance a canary ladder automatically while health signals stay clean, and roll back to a named revision.

capabilities.name: Request retry
capabilities.description: Replay a transport-failed request against a different healthy instance within hard per-request and aggregate app budgets; POST/PATCH also require explicit opt-in and an Idempotency-Key.

capabilities.name: Critical route health during canaries
capabilities.description: Compare 5xx, latency and watched 4xx rates on selected routes between a canary and the stable deployment, report or hold progression, seed report-mode selectors from observed customer reach for unconfigured apps, and pool stage evidence for low-traffic routes.

capabilities.name: Route lifecycle review
capabilities.description: Reconcile a deployment's captured contract, source and observed traffic to surface route drift and retirement candidates, with approvals, deprecation headers and history.

capabilities.name: Route requirements and policy plans
capabilities.description: Keep per-route authentication, throttle and budget expectations in version control, check them against previews and deployments, and apply reviewed repair plans.

capabilities.name: Route source impact
capabilities.description: Statically map a source diff to the FastAPI, Go HTTP, Express or Hono endpoints it can affect, and compare discovered routes with an OpenAPI document, offline.

capabilities.name: Scale to zero
capabilities.description: Park idle APIs and wake them on the next request.

capabilities.name: Source deploys
capabilities.description: Deploy an API from a local source tree, tarball, Dockerfile, or OCI image.

capabilities.name: Streaming and gRPC
capabilities.description: Serve streaming HTTP responses, SSE, and gRPC APIs.

capabilities.name: Worker pools
capabilities.description: Run long-lived non-HTTP OCI workers with queue bindings and queue-depth scaling.

capabilities.name: Jobs and workflows
capabilities.description: Run asynchronous jobs and durable workflows alongside an API.
